https://ourworldindata.org/what-do-people-die-from-in-different-countries
Poorer countries still deal more with infectious diseases and child/maternal deaths, while richer countries mostly deal with aging-related illnesses, and overall it’sa reminder that everyday health issues matter way more than the things people usually fear.

https://priceonomics.com/how-has-cryptocurrency-mining-influenced-gpu-prices/
Since mining uses GPUs for heavy calculations, demand exploded during crypto booms, creating shortages and making gaming hardware way more expensive, and then when crypto cooled off or changed systems, prices started stabilizing again.
